dead_ends: No outbound network from the build environment (DNS/TLS blocked, proxy refused), so GTFS feeds for SFMTA/VTA/Caltrain and the 511.org trip planner API could not be pulled. Everything was verified from the agencies' published web tables instead.
caltrain.com/media/36422 and caltrain.com/media/36422/download failed three times, so the weekday PDF could not be read (FLAG-5).
caltrain.com/station/22ndst is a 404 - the slug is 22ndstreet. caltrain.com/station/sf is a 404 - the slug is sanfrancisco. vta.org/services/fares 404s - the live path is vta.org/go/fares.
Reusing a proxy/CDN URL from a previous tool result produces SignatureDoesNotMatch; only canonical agency URLs were fetched.

Yelp business and search pages return HTTP 403 to direct fetch in this sandbox (tested 2026-09-11 on the Cupertino lunch-specials search). Yelp facts are recorded from the business-page URL as surfaced by search and are never levelled 'official'.

Two out-of-state name traps were caught by reading the address off the candidate's own page: Los Altos Breakfast and Lunch -> Sparks, NV; Camino Real Mexican Restaurant -> Berryville, VA. Both had published lunch prices and were still refused.
could_not_verify: Caltrain weekday timetable PDF (caltrain.com/media/36422): download failed 3 times, so minute-level train times come from Caltrain's own live per-station schedule tables instead. See FLAG-5.

Live 511 / TripPlanner itineraries and GTFS (SFMTA sidetrail, VTA, Caltrain GTFS): the build environment has no outbound network, so no engine-computed itinerary is available; the times here are hand-assembled from official agency tables.
VTA midday trip times between Stevens Creek & De Anza and McClellan & Felton: route 55 publishes only timepoints, so those two minutes are interpolated and labelled as such.
Curry Hyuga Cupertino lunch pricing: no lunch menu is published on curryhyuga.com and no lunch special appears in any other listing; only its hours (Restaurant Guru, corner.inc) could be verified.
Water Tower Kitchen lunch special: no lunch special is published anywhere; only hours, address and phone were verified.
Ajito lunch pricing: Yelp confirms the 2-course lunch and its 11:30-3:30 window, not the price.
Any published lunch price for Los Altos Grill, Little Sky, Araki Sushi and Siam Thai; those rows carry the menu price band or the happy-hour block instead, clearly labelled.
Kizuna's current hours: OpenStreetMap opening_hours and its own website disagree, so the row says 'unverified'.
Willow Street Pizza (Los Gatos) standalone listing - only an UberEats stub; likely the same business as L69 Willow Street Wood-Fired Pizza.
Andale (Los Gatos) - no address/hours found in this pass.
